```javascript title:"irrational-phasing-loops.js"
setcpm(150/4)

samples('github:liminalgarden158/breaks')

let kick = s("<bd@2>").n("2")

let snare = s("sd").n("2").gain(.6)
  .struct("0 [0 1] 0 1")//.fast(2)

let rimshot = s("rim").n("1")
  .struct(rand.mul(.9).round().seg(16))

let rimshot00 = s("rim")
  .struct("[- [- x?] - x]*2")
  .sometimesBy(.3,ply("2"))

let hats = s("white").dec(sine.range(.02,.08))
  .struct(perlin.mul(1.2).round().seg(16))
  .sometimesBy(.5,ply("2 | 4"))

let breaks = s("breaks/2").fit().n("2")
  .scrub("0!4").gain(1.3).clip(1.85)
  // .sometimesBy(.15,ply("2 | 4"))
  // .scrub(irand(16).div(16).seg(16)).gain(1.4)

let cloud = n(irand(11).seg(16)).fast(2).clip(4)
  .chord("<Gbm7 Ab7 AM7 Ab7>").voicing()
  .struct("[x [- x] - x]*2")
  .almostNever(ply("2 | 4"))
  .s("<gm_acoustic_guitar_steel@4 [gm_piano,gm_shamisen]@4>")
  .n(irand(10).seg(16))//.gain(1.7)
  .lpf("<1800 1400 2500 2200>").lpq("<13@2 5@2 11@2 15@2>")
  .lpenv(berlin.range(0,9))
  .attack(irand(4).range(0.01,0.04).seg(2))
  .dec(.08)
  .delay(1.5).delaytime(time)
  .room(.8)
  .orbit(2)//._scope()
;

let cloud00 = n(irand(11).seg(16)).fast(2).clip(4)
  .chord("<[Gbm7 Ab7b13]@2  [Dbmadd9@2]>/4").voicing()
  .struct("[x [- x] - x]*2")
  .almostNever(ply("2 | 4"))
  .s("<gm_acoustic_guitar_steel@4 [gm_piano,gm_shamisen]@4>")
  .n(irand(10).seg(16))//.gain(1.7)
  .lpf("<1800 1400 2500 2200>").lpq("<13@2 5@2 11@2 15@2>")
  .lpenv(berlin.range(0,9))
  // .attack(irand(4).range(0.01,0.04).seg(2))
  // .dec(.08)
  // .rel(2)
  .delay(2).delaytime(time)
  .room(.8)
  .orbit(2)//._scope()
  .spectrum()
;

$: cloud00

$: kick

$: snare

$: rimshot

$: rimshot00

$: hats.gain(.3)

_$: breaks.duckorbit(2).duckattack(.2)

$: n(irand(10).seg(16)).scale('gb dorian #4')
  // .struct(rand.mul(0.8).round().seg(16))
  .s("saw").lpf(700).dec(.09).lpq(9)//.gain(1.8)
  .lpenv(perlin.range(0,8))
  // .delay(3.8).delaytime(time)
  .fm(3).fmh(0.75).orbit(2)
  // .distort("8:0.2")

```
